def count_rotation(arr):
    """Return how many rotations produced arr from a sorted array.

    The count is the first index i where arr[i] < arr[i - 1].
    An array with no such drop is already sorted and returns 0.
    """
    for i in range(1, len(arr)):
        if arr[i] < arr[i - 1]:
            return i
    return 0
